newsitem.title: USA: Five die in Sacramento, Calif., house fire.
newsitem.headline: Five die in Sacramento, Calif., house fire.

text.p: Five members of the same family were killed Sunday in a house fire in a suburb of Sacramento, authorities said.
The early morning blaze in the suburb of Rancho Cordova killed a woman and four of her children. The children were age 9, 7, 6 and 2.
Their father was not at home at the time, said Sgt. Jim Cooper of the Sacramento County sheriff's department.
Arson investigators and an arson dog were sent to the scene to try to determine the cause of the blaze.
"It was a very hot fire and it moved very quickly," said Sgt. Paul Hauptman. "When it moves that fast it makes you suspicious."
The names of the victims were not released.
